a.lede: AI infrastructure startup Fireworks has disclosed a new security breach in which attackers accessed its development machines after breaching a third-party cloud provider. [...]
a.title: Fireworks AI discloses new breach after cloud provider hack

b.lede: Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama, the operator of the Iris Plaza shopping platform, disclosed that personal information belonging to about 7.7 million people may have been exposed after unauthorized access to a third-party cloud service the company used. [...]
b.title: Iris Ohyama data cloud breach exposes info of 7.7 million customers
